body.description: Name, note and roles for the new credential. All optional.

name.description: Short name for this credential, included in the generated client ID so it is recognisable in the realm's client list, e.g. `terraform` produces `api-terraform-9f3c1a2b`. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 48 characters. Optional.

description.description: Free-text note recorded on the client so credentials can be told apart later, e.g. which pipeline or workstation holds it. Optional, but revoking the right one later is much easier with it.

roles.description: `realm-management` client roles to grant, e.g. `["view-users", "view-realm"]`. Defaults to `["realm-admin"]`, which is full administrative access to the realm and what the Keycloak Terraform provider generally needs. Narrow this where you can: a credential that only reads should only be able to read. Roles that do not exist are rejected rather than quietly skipped.
